run_convert_selective_search: run the script to convert Selective Search proposal boxes into Detectron proposal file format
run_json_dataset_get_roidb: run JsonDataset to load a dataset and retrieve its region of interest database
run_scipy_loadmat: run scipy.io.loadmat to load MATLAB .mat files containing selective search box data
run_save_object: run save_object to persist boxes, scores, and indexes to a Detectron proposal file
run_coordinate_conversion: run the script to convert 1-indexed yxyx selective search boxes to 0-indexed xyxy format
